rationale: Gate all events on a violation-free inclusive window. This covers reset rows and stall rows. Trail and lead are now attributed per CSID bit. P10 and P15 are reconciled with the code: no tolerance, the additive idle case is blocking unresolved, and edges-per-byte is declared as a modelling assumption.
